title.en: Sampling means from a skewed population

summary: Compare individual Bernoulli draws with the distribution of repeated sample means.
objective: Show repeated sample means from a Bernoulli population and compare their spread with sqrt(p*(1-p)/n).
intent_signals: Show repeated sample means from a Bernoulli population and compare their spread with sqrt(p*(1-p)/n).
Compare individual Bernoulli draws with the distribution of repeated sample means.
example_prompts: Show repeated sample means from a Bernoulli population and compare their spread with sqrt(p*(1-p)/n).
Create an explorable 3D explanation of sampling distribution of the mean with mean histogram.
negative_signals: Do not promise a universal n=30 threshold or normality for arbitrary dependent or infinite-variance data.
not_for: Do not promise a universal n=30 threshold or normality for arbitrary dependent or infinite-variance data.

entities.name: Population tray
entities.guidance: Use labeled 0 and 1 outcome bins with declared probability p; separate population probabilities from the latest sample tokens.

entities.name: Replicate lane
entities.guidance: Show n outcome tokens and a mean marker per selected replicate; depth stacks replicate identities without implying a third measured variable.

entities.name: Mean histogram
entities.guidance: Use explicit bin edges on [0,1], normalized counts and a theoretical mean/standard-error ruler; label any density-normalized overlay separately.

state_contract.model: Use n>=1 independent Bernoulli(p) draws per replicate, 0<p<1. The mean is success count/n; exact mean p and standard error sqrt(p*(1-p)/n). Normal shape is an approximation whose quality depends on n and p.
state_contract.authority: A seeded array of completed replicate samples owns every mean and histogram count; the normal overlay is derived theory, not fitted evidence.
actions: Generate a fixed number of replicates.
Increase sample size while restarting with a recorded seed.
Choose a strongly skewed p and compare approximation quality.
Inspect one replicate or reset all samples.

invariants: Every sample mean is an integer multiple of 1/n.
Histogram counts equal the number of completed replicates.
Individual draw variability and standard error of the mean have separate labels.
motion_guidance: Accumulate a mean only after its n draws complete; partial sample averages must be marked unfinished.
Replay does not resample; pause freezes the pending replicate index.
known_limits: Do not promise a universal n=30 threshold or normality for arbitrary dependent or infinite-variance data.
At p=0 or 1 the distribution is degenerate; reject those inputs here or provide an explicit point-mass mode.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: For independent identically distributed samples with finite variance, the sample mean has standard error sigma/sqrt(n); its standardized distribution approaches normal under the central limit theorem.
claims.scope: Asymptotic statement, not exact finite-sample normality; Bernoulli variance is p*(1-p).

object_craft.structure: Use labeled 0 and 1 outcome bins with declared probability p; separate population probabilities from the latest sample tokens.
object_craft.material: Discrete sample tokens and neutral histogram bins; retain numeric counts so perspective does not become the only comparison cue.
